            Modern Hospital

It provides an intuitive platform where visitors can explore hospital facilities, medical services, doctor information, and essential healthcare resources through a clean and user-friendly interface. This project demonstrates my skills in building modern, accessible, and user-focused web experiences.

            Red Pulse - Mobile App

            TEAM PROJECT

            Red Pulse is an Android Blood Donation Management Application developed to connect blood donors with people in need of blood. It helps users find donors, explore live blood requests, and manage blood donation activities through a user-friendly interface. This project was developed collaboratively by a team of five university students as part of our university lab project.
